interface.title: EOZ / Decentration Analysis — Pentacam TCDM
interface.stage_of_work: Post-operative outcome measurement and analysis of a cohort of eyes
interface.what_it_is_for: Measures the effective optical zone (EOZ) on a Pentacam anterior tangential difference-map screenshot: its area, ellipse axes, retention ratio against the programmed optical zone, and how far the ablation sits from the corneal vertex and from the intended target. It does this one eye at a time or for a batch of screenshots.

data.note: I uploaded example-pentacam-map.png (a 1300x720 OCULUS Pentacam 4-map export, Difference A−B, left eye) through Open file… and again through the Batch analysis file chooser. Auto-calibration gave 24.0 px/mm, vertex at px 1051.5,564.5 and '75 scale blocks'. Some UI text, dialogs and the HTML report are partly in Turkish (for example the ID prompt 'Goz / hasta kimligi:' and 'Kalite uyarilari'). The Map direction toggle label shows as 'Pre2192Post' (or 'Post2192Pre') because of an arrow-encoding glitch. The batch progress bar stops short of full at '1 / 1 succeeded' (screens/022.webp; the checker saw it about a third full). In the batch HTML report run under the hue-threshold method, the method note still says '0.00 D iso-contour' while its quality warning says the scale was not found, so the two disagree.

tree.general: Measure the size, shape and centring of a treated zone on a 2-D difference map, for single cases and for a cohort
tree.specific: Measure EOZ size, ellipse axes, retention ratio (RR) and decentration (dec_CV, dec_TC) from Pentacam tangential difference-map screenshots

scroll to pan to the region of interest

features.name: Automatic scale and origin calibration with manual override

check the px/mm field and the header badge
optionally type a px/mm value or re-click the vertex

features.name: Iso-contour boundary extraction with ellipse fit and choice of method
features.general: Extract a region boundary from a colour-coded map at a value read from the colour scale, or by colour thresholds as a fallback. Fit an ellipse and report area, equivalent diameter, axes with orientation, eccentricity, irregularity and the centre (from the ellipse or from the area centroid). The map's subtraction direction must be set to match the image
features.specific: Boundary method scale (0.00 D) or the hue-threshold fallback (inner/outer hue values), Center: ellipse fit or area centroid, Map: Pre→Post / Post→Pre direction (swaps the hue thresholds; a mismatch fits the whole map edge), then Analyze; the EOZ ellipse and axes are drawn on the map
steps: set the map direction to match the subtraction
choose the boundary method (scale 0.00 D, or hue threshold if the scale cannot be read) and optionally adjust the hue thresholds
choose the centre definition
press Analyze
inspect the ellipse overlay, the Result table and its quality warnings
serves_tasks: Set the subtraction direction of the difference map so the treated zone is read with the right sign
Extract the zone boundary, fit an ellipse and report size, shape and ratio to the planned size
Set the planned zone size for the case, which is the denominator of the size ratio
When the value scale on the image cannot be read, fall back to detecting the boundary from colour thresholds, and tune the threshold
Choose how the centre of the measured zone is defined

features.name: Dual-reference decentration with an intended-offset vector
features.general: Compute how far a measured centre lies from a fixed anatomical origin and from an intended target, where the target is a marked landmark plus an entered offset with selectable sign conventions
features.specific: Mark the pupil, enter Px/Py with +Px right/left and +Py up/down conventions; the Result shows dec_CV (ablation − vertex) and dec_TC (ablation − TC, where TC = pupil + Px,Py), plus pupil offset (chord mu) and residual centration gap
steps: mark the pupil centre
type Px and Py
set the sign conventions for +Px and +Py
press Analyze
compare dec_CV and dec_TC
serves_tasks: Mark a second anatomical reference and an intended offset, then measure decentration from the intended target

screens_never_reached: Batch 'Stop' control and the time-remaining estimate: these are mentioned in the batch info, but the single-file batch finished at once
Vertex-fallback / 'ring' vertex-source state described in 'How is this computed?': not triggered by the example image (the vertex source stayed 'fixed template coordinate')
Drag-and-drop onto the map drop zone: the browser tools cannot drop files, so I used Open file… instead
not_done: I could not batch several distinct eyes: only one test image is available, so the batch summary statistics have n = 1
I did not open or inspect eoz_qc.png: it is binary and can only be confirmed as downloaded
Keyboard shortcuts (+/−/0) did not respond when I pressed 0, because focus was on the loupe slider; I used the buttons and Ctrl+wheel instead
I did not read the info (i) popovers for Load map, Px/Py, centre mode and boundary definition; I opened only the marking and batch info and the 'How is this computed?' modal
